subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**them**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the deltaic regions of India.
 
• In the fifth filler, '**them**' should be used because after a **preposition** (**of**) we should use the **objective case** of the **pronoun**.
 
• In the given context, '**them**' is the objective case of '**they**'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

Correct Passage:__* The predominantly deltaic eastern coastal plain is an area of deep sedimentation. Over __most__ (1) of its length it is considerably wider __than__ (2) the plain on the western coast. __The__ (3) major deltas, from south to north, __are__ (4) of the Kaveri, the Krishna-Godavari, the Mahanadi, and the Ganges-Brahmaputra rivers. The last of __**them**__ **(5)** is some 190 miles (300 km) wide, but only about one-third of it lies within India.*
